location.zh: 精灵太空站 勇者之塔 神秘领域

capture.zh: 第6封印：技能PP无限。 击败后解开该封印，进入下一封印；七个封印全部解开后挑战谱尼真身才能获得谱尼精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 不能耗招：哈莫雷特（体力、攻击努力值）首发龙之意志两次后吃血补满，血量保持300以上强化到6次再攻击；遇圣光气用回避两次；被致命一击打掉防御强化后重新强化。

engine_notes: unlimited_pp: the PP-exhaust strategy of seals 1-5 is impossible.
HP 13000 is the official map-108 table.
A later summary instead gives this seal 'below 1000 HP → full heal'; not in the 2010 source.

Skills (4399 2010-10 seal guides, identical for every seal): 圣光气 10PP, 旋灭裂空阵 10PP, 圣灵魔闪光 5PP, 千烈虚光闪 10PP — 35 PP in total. 圣光气 makes its next two attacks certain crits (下两次攻击必定致命); the classic answer was to switch in two throw-away pets.
Level 105 (seal 1: 101) is the official map-108 boss table (seer_data maps.json); the client displays ?? above 100.
Unlock of the whole line: light the two small lamps beside 勇者之塔 in the 精灵太空站 resource area, then enter the red 神秘领域 (4399 谱尼 page).
Reward: none for the seal itself; clearing it unlocks the next stage of the 'puni' campaign (src/domain/challenges/challenge-campaigns.ts).
谱尼的领域 admits only a bag of six level-100 monsters (2013 client MapProcess_108 checkBag(6,100)).
Immune to stat drops: 7k7k 2010-07-21 永恒：技能PP无限、不受状态下降影响. Innate boost: 52pk 2013-02-05 同时天生有强化 (stat not stated, so atk+2; no 2010 source mentions it).
source_note: 4399 谱尼攻略 series (2010-10, one page per seal) for the seal rules and skills/PP; HP from a later baidu jingyan summary (5000/6000/7000/8000/9000 for seals 1-5).
